title: Dispatch CTW 7: Hollow Junction Line Is Restored for One Night
summary: The Post Office sends the reply its operators never received.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Mr. Bell rejoined the abandoned copper for a controlled test. An operator tapped, “Eastbound held. Bridge safe after repair.” The paper tape recorded the message. A faint answer came back in the rhythm of Hollow Junction’s sign-off, but no words were heard.

The local clock loop remained quiet. Railway officials reopened the bridge after loading tests. The Post Office will decide whether to leave the old circuit buried or preserve its short section in the communications museum.
